seat.note: sit_idle frame 0, metres, three.js axes relative to the feet origin (y up, +z = facing). seatSurfaceY = underside below the pelvis, where the chair seat top goes: place the model at chairSeatTopY - seatSurfaceY. Every sit_* clip has the same mean hips position as sit_idle, so one placement serves all five.
